name: calm-recap
description: Calm Recap: a Welcome back card when you return to the keyboard, and the prompt cache's hit rate and time left in your status line.

buttonLabel.title: Button label
buttonLabel.description: The words on the on/off button, up to 20 characters.

jobNaming.title: Job naming
jobNaming.description: Ask Haiku for a 2 to 6 word name for each job, shown in the done line after Claude answers. Off uses the start of your message.

cyberpunk.title: Cyberpunk theme
cyberpunk.description: Neon pink titles, cyan accents and yellow alerts.

awayMinutes.title: Away after (minutes)
awayMinutes.description: Minutes of quiet after Claude answers before the Welcome back card appears (1 to 120).

recapStyle.title: Recap style
recapStyle.description: Where the Welcome back recap reads: band (above the prompt, fitted to its rows) or pane (a larger panel of its own).

weatherCity.title: Weather city
weatherCity.description: A city for the weather, e.g. "Khon Kaen" (found with Open-Meteo's place search). Leave blank to work it out from your internet address, which can be off by a city or more.

weather.title: Weather
weather.description: Show your city, a weather symbol and the temperature beside the gear, e.g. "📍 Bangkok ⛅ 31°C". Your city is looked up from your internet address (ipwho.is) at most once an hour; the reading comes from Open-Meteo every 15 minutes.

cacheMeter.title: Cache in status line
cacheMeter.description: Whether the cache meter is in your status line. Change it with the button in the settings panel or /recap statusline on|off, which edit your status line for you.
